releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.2
releases.body:
## What's new

### Android: an in-game menu
- In the game, press **Back three times** quickly (or **Guide** on a controller) to open the pause menu. The game pauses while it is open.
- The menu has:
  - **Resume**
  - **Frame rate**: takes effect after a restart, and the menu says so.
  - **Touch controls**: Off / Default / Always. Changes apply right away and are saved.
  - **Report a bug**
  - **Quit to launcher**: asks you to confirm first.
- Use it with touch or a controller: A selects; B, Back, Start or Guide close it.

### Launchers in your language
- The PC and phone launchers now come in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, following the system language.
- On PC, set `B3_LANG=en`, `zh` or `ja` to choose one yourself.

### Phone: add the app to game mode
- Some phones keep CPU clocks low for apps that are not on the system's game list. The launcher now shows a gold card asking you to add the app to the phone's game mode or game center; otherwise the game may not run at full speed.
- Tap **Done, hide this** once you've added it.
- A line under **START** reminds you how to open the in-game menu.

### Not yet tested on a device
- **Tested on a phone:** triple Back.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.1
releases.body:
A fix for a crash after saving.

## Fixes

- **`FATAL: ipc: unimplemented service 'pl:u'` after a save (#12).** On some screens the game asks for the list of system fonts in order of priority. That request went to a system service we don't have, and the game stopped. The fonts it gets are the same ones the game already uses everywhere else, so text is unchanged. Thanks to the reporter in #12 for the log!

## Verified

- The game builds and starts on Windows, and the font request is now answered by the runtime instead of the missing service.
- The screen that makes the request wasn't reached in our own test, so please tell us in #12 if it still happens.

## Coming from v0.4.0

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files stay, in Internal storage or on the SD card, wherever you chose.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.0
releases.body:
The Android app can now keep the game on an SD card.

## New

- **Game folder on an SD card (Android, experimental).** Settings has a new **Game folder** row: choose Internal storage or an inserted SD card (or USB drive). Suggested in #12.
  - **Not set up yet:** choose the card first and put your dump on it (`Bayonetta 3/dump`, Download or Documents on the card). **SET UP** then puts the game there. The setup looks on the chosen storage first. A dump on the other storage also works, but it is copied, so it needs as much free space again. The free-space check counts that.
  - **Already set up:** choosing the card offers to **move** the game there: game data, saves, settings and shader cache. Everything is copied first, and the old folder is removed only after every file has arrived. If the move stops halfway, the game stays where it was.
  - **A card that already holds the game** is used as it is.
  - The built game itself stays in the app's private storage, so the SD card only needs to hold data. Use an exFAT card: FAT32 can't hold files of 4 GB or more.
  - **Send to my phone** now copies the game into the folder chosen in the app.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.17
releases.body:
Know before you set up: the app and the launchers now check whether your device can run the game.

## New

- **A minimum spec, checked for you.** Below it, setting up takes 30 to 60 minutes and can end in a black screen, so the app and launchers now say so first. Below the minimum they stop by default and explain why, with a choice to try anyway. If a device only falls short of the recommended spec, you get a warning.
  - **Android:** the app checks when it opens and again before **SET UP** or **START**. Minimum: Vulkan 1.3, a CPU core at 2.4 GHz or faster, 6 GB of memory, and an Adreno 640 / Mali-G68 class GPU or newer. Older Mali GPUs (G31 to G76), Mali-T, PowerVR and Maleoon are below it. Recommended: Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer with 8 GB.
  - **Send to my phone** checks the phone before it builds anything, and asks before sending to a phone below the minimum (`b3_win.py phone --anyway` on the command line).

releases.name: GTA Stories Recompiled 0.3.2
releases.body:
GTA Stories Recompiled 0.3.2

Fixes
- LCS: every weapon shot at the same spot in free aim (#6). Fixed in the app; your game library keeps working. Android and PC.
- Black picture on the phone's own graphics driver (seen on an Adreno 840): the driver refused the game's draw steps. Fixed there; other Adreno phones may have had the same problem. Not tested on other phones.
- Black bar at the bottom with 3-button navigation (#1): the game now draws edge to edge. Only gesture navigation was tested here; please report if the bar is still there.
- Mali GPUs failed to start (no dual-source blending): there is now a fallback. Untested, no Mali phone here.

New

- Saves > Back up all saves and Restore a backup. Saves live only inside the app: uninstalling it or clearing its data deletes them, so back up before updating.
- Settings shows the size of each data folder and the free space (#3). The game library cannot move to external storage.

releases.body:
This release features many experimental/WIP Android improvements by @kleidis that you can test before they eventually get merged into [Azahar](https://github.com/azahar-emu/azahar). It also brings up various third-party dependencies to their latest major versions, and includes some very minor bug fixes.

There is also [a beta release](https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/releases/tag/v2025.01.23-sdl-compat) that is the same as this one except that it incorporates the use of SDL3 via the SDL2 compatability layer. The intent is to port this project over to pure SDL3 eventually, but the compatability layer approach allows people to play around with things while waiting for the porting to be completed. This also gives this project a fallback in case SDL2 stops being supported upstream but new functionality such as gamepad support for new game controllers continues to be updated on the SDL3 branch.

### What's Changed
* Android: Some minor fixes by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/293
* renderer_opengl: Enable a couple of optimizations by @rtiangha in https://github.com/Borked3DS/Borked3DS/pull/294

# FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE · Android 原生移植版 v1.1.0 发布说明

- **版本号**：`v1.1.0`（`versionCode=80`，`org.ffrs.gamewindow`）
- **通用安装包**：`FFRS-1.1.0-universal.apk`（`arm64-v8a`，全平台通用）

---

## 本版本主要更新

### 1. 通用性能优化（骁龙 / 天玑全平台适用）
- **描述符与同步热路径优化**：新增图形 `PushMemo` 负载缓存、`PushMemoTexel` 原地刷新与 `SlotSets` 惰性分配，大幅降低重复描述符构建开销；扩大 `push_memo_map` 容量上限至 `32768`，避免复杂大场景频繁整表清空。
- **瞬态着色器自适应旁路**：新增 `PushMemoShaderState` 机制，自动识别连续未命中的瞬态着色器并临时旁路查表，减少无效哈希计算。
- **屏障与状态查询精简**：收窄 `texel` 与 `compute_barrier()` 管线屏障，合并 `pending_view()` 单趟重叠检查，缓存 `VkFormatProperties3` 并跳过只读纹理的重复 `prepare_read`。
- **洞窟场景闪烁修复**：修复洞窟路段左右移动时偶发的右半屏隔帧闪烁问题，保持全场景画面完整稳定输出。

### 2. 完整内置功能
- **画质与帧率设置**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **画质与帧率**）：
  - **帧率上限**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 30 FPS / 40 FPS / 60 FPS`，调节后实时生效，无需重启。
  - **画面输出档位**：支持 `沿用原设置 / 720p 输出 / 1080p 输出`，保存并重开游戏后生效。
- **内置中文金手指**（顶部菜单 `≡` → **金手指**，勾选保存并重启生效）：
  - 移动速度 2 倍
  - 不遇敌（按住 R3 临时恢复正常）
  - 战斗掉落率 100%
  - 战斗经验值 2 倍
  - 战斗金币 2 倍
  - 角色存档修改

### 3. 虚拟手柄默认布局优化
- 缩小肩键（`L1/L2/R1/R2`）与功能键（`- / +`）尺寸，将肩键下移至左右中侧边缘，避免遮挡左上角帧率/任务信息与右上角小地图。
- 对称对齐左右摇杆、`L3/R3`、十字键与 `A/B/X/Y` 菱形按键间距，默认布局更紧凑清晰（仍支持在「编辑按键布局」中自由微调或重置）。

---

## 安装与使用提示
- 请确保设备存储根目录已放置合法导出的游戏数据目录 `/sdcard/FFRS`。

releases.body:
# Let's Go Launcher 0.3

This is the third release of Let's Go Launcher. It brings the game from barely playable on Mali to a real frame rate on weak devices, and fixes the boot failure that stopped the game from opening on some phones.

## Measured performance (Galaxy S20+, Mali-G77, heavy scene)

- **~13.6 fps → 16–20 fps, average ~17.6, peak 20.1** (measured over a 73-second session in the heavy scene; the previous build averaged ~13.6 fps there)
- The game is now GPU-bound (~96% GPU busy, ~23% CPU) — the CPU is no longer the wall
- With a warm pipeline cache, indoor battles reached 23–26 fps
- No crashes in the test session

## What's new in 0.3

# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2611/)
You know the drill, it's been around a month so that means we have a new release landing. A smattering of changes all over the codebase this time.
Let's see what's interesting!

## CPU core index through TPIDRRO_EL0
This is a fun feature that has come about primarily because Windows on ARM mandates this feature. The [TPIDRRO_EL0](https://support.arm.com/documentation/ddi0601/2026-09/AArch64-Registers/TPIDRRO-EL0--EL0-Read-Only-Software-Thread-ID-Register?lang=en) register
is an ARM system register that is readable by userspace that the kernel can set to whatever 64-bit value it wants. In particular under Windows it is

releases.name: Xenoblade DE port v0.16.1
releases.body:
## Runtime update (no visible change in this port)

This release carries a fix from the Catherine port's runtime, which both ports share.

Some games bind a block of shader constants that is shorter than what their shader actually reads. On the console the bytes just past the block are the next bytes of the game's own structure; the port was filling them with zeros. It now copies them from the game's memory up to the next 16-byte boundary and keeps zeros beyond that.

**Nothing changes in Xenoblade: its G-buffer vertex shader reads up to 368 bytes with 256 bound, and 256 is already a multiple of 16, so it keeps getting zeros — exactly as before.** Re-verified on the Flip 2 with a copy of the save: characters whole (Shulk with the Monado, the party), 30.1 fps in battle, saves untouched.

## En español

Esta versión trae un arreglo del runtime que comparte con el port de Catherine.

releases.name: Xenoblade DE port v0.16.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/xenoblade-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

releases.name: v0.14.0
releases.body:
## Sharper 3D

- **The 3D image is upscaled with AMD FSR 1 before the game adds its interface.** The game draws its 3D at a dynamic resolution (for example 704×416 in handheld mode) and stretched it to its 720p window with a simple filter; on the Flip 2 that 720p image was then stretched again to the 1080p screen. Now FSR rebuilds the 3D at 720p first, and the step to 1080p sharpens instead of only stretching. The interface is untouched. The difference is largest in TV mode, where the 3D is narrowest.
- It costs about 2.8 ms of GPU per frame and turns itself off for a moment when a heavy scene would not fit in the 30 fps frame. Measured on the Flip 2 in the open field: 30 fps in handheld and TV mode.

# WWE '12 PC 1.5.0 "Small PCs"

This version is about PCs with few or slow CPU cores: a start-up freeze is fixed, parts of the game run faster, and there is a new FPS counter. It also fixes two Universe problems.

## Fixes

- **Fixed a rare freeze on "NOW LOADING" at start-up** on PCs with few or slow CPU cores (a race between the game's sound-bank loading threads). The game could stay on the first loading screen forever. On a test PC limited to 2 slow cores it froze in 2 starts out of 10 before the fix and never in 10 starts after it (#69, #74: if your freeze has another cause, tell us). 
- **No more loading-screen speed-up on PCs with fewer than 8 usable threads**, where it could lock the game at its frame barrier.
- **Universe: SmackDown (and other weekly shows) no longer end up with only 0-1 match** when their roster is small: a match that would be dropped because everyone is resting now takes a rested Superstar instead.

releases.name: WWE '12 PC 1.4.1
releases.body:
# WWE '12 PC 1.4.1

A small update after 1.4.0: a Royal Rumble crash fixed, and belt modding in the Mod Maker.

## Fixes

**WWE '12 PC v1.3.0 — "Speed and fixes"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Faster
- **Loading screens shorter** (a match loads in about 1.5 s instead of 4 s, the end of the entrances in about 1.9 s instead of 4.5 s). `wwe12_fast_loading = false` brings the old behaviour back.
- **Faster start-up** on PCs with 8 or more logical processors: the title screen comes after about 5-7 s instead of 15 s. On smaller processors the normal start-up is kept (`wwe12_fast_boot_min_threads`).
- **Sharper picture** when the game is drawn at 720p on a bigger screen (`svr_upscale_sharpness`, 0 turns it off).
- **Adaptive V-sync**: a late frame is shown at once instead of waiting a whole refresh (`svr_adaptive_vsync`).
- **Performance test** in the launcher (button *Performance test*): it plays a recorded 1-on-1 match with entrances once and tells you if your PC is fine, limited by the processor or by the graphics card. Nothing is changed without your agreement.

### Frame rate

**WWE '12 PC v1.2.0 — "Moveset update"**

> ⚠️ No game data included: you need your own copy of WWE '12 for Xbox 360.

### Fixed
- **Match-start stutter (and a short freeze) on integrated graphics (Intel...)**: the game's reads of the picture back from the graphics card are now grouped at the end of the frame (about 10 times less waiting at the start of a match). `svr_readback_defer_streak = false` goes back to 1.1.

- **Crash at start with file names that have accents or other characters** (for example a song called "Café.mp3" or a mod folder with Japanese letters in a mod): names are now read as UTF-8 everywhere in the game, the launcher and the Mod Maker, and a mod with an unreadable name is skipped instead of closing the game.

releases.name: v1.2.6: save backups, movies keep their shape, every controller works
releases.body:
**Save backups, movies that keep their shape, and two controllers at once.**

- **Save backups** (*CTRL → Game → Save backups …*): copies of all your save slots in a folder you choose, outside the app, so uninstalling the game doesn't delete them. A copy is made after the game saves, at most every 10 minutes. The latest 10 and one for each of the last 7 days played are kept, up to 64 MB in all (the latest 3 always). A backup can be restored from the same screen; it takes effect at the next start, and the saves it replaces are kept aside.
- **Movies are never stretched.** They keep their 16:9 shape with **Wide screen** on, and now also with **Stretch to fill wide screens** on. A movie whose own picture has black bars at the top and bottom as well (bars on all four sides) is zoomed in, centred, until one pair of bars is gone, without cutting anything off.
- **Controllers:** every connected controller now controls the game. Before, with two connected (for example a handheld's built-in controls and an external pad), the second one's buttons were ignored.

releases.name: v1.2.5: render resolution and true wide screens
releases.body:
**Choose the render resolution, and true wide screens.**

- **Resolution** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): **540p**, **720p** (as on the Xbox 360, the default) or **1080p**. The 3D world is drawn at that size; menus and the HUD stay sharp at 720p. 540p is faster and a little softer. 1080p is scaled down into the 720p picture, which smooths edges rather than adding detail, and needs a fast GPU.
- **Wide screen** (*CTRL → Image*, applies at the next start): on screens wider than 16:9 (most phones), the 3D world fills the whole screen, with more to see at the sides instead of black bars or stretching. Menus, the HUD and the minimap stay in the middle, laid out as on a 16:9 screen, and movies keep 16:9 with black bars. It costs some speed: on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) the field runs at about 24.5 fps instead of 28. Off by default.
- With both left at their defaults, the picture is the same as in v1.2.4.

releases.name: v1.2.4: tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, fixes for more phones
releases.body:
**A tidier CTRL menu with Exit game, and fixes for more phones from the Dark Souls II port.**

- **CTRL menu:** the options are now in sections that open one at a time: *Controls*, *Frame rate and performance*, *Image*, *Second screen*, *Game* and *Troubleshooting*. **Exit game** (top right) closes the game after asking; save in the game's main menu first. After changing an option marked *, the menu offers to restart the game so it takes effect.
- **CTRL button:** under *Controls* it can stay on screen, slide into a small tab when not in use, or go away 30 seconds after the game starts. Once it's gone, Android's Back button or gesture opens the menu.
- **Frame rate:** one list with 30, 40, 60 and *60 fps, smoother* (the former 120 Hz option).
- **Mali GPUs (Dimensity, Exynos, Tensor):** the app now starts on Arm's own driver, with the renderer settings that fixed Mali players' glitches in the Dark Souls II port, which shares this renderer. Still untested on a real Mali phone: reports with logs are welcome.
- **Adreno 8xx (Snapdragon 8 Elite):** Turnip now runs in sysmem mode there, which fixed GPU hangs on these chips in the Dark Souls II port.

releases.name: v1.2.3: fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs
releases.body:
**Fix for Adreno 600-series GPUs (Snapdragon 855 / 865 / 870 / 888 and similar).**

- **Adreno 6xx:** the renderer no longer loses work on these GPUs. Missing menu text, garbled or black pictures and wrong colours came from the Turnip driver on Adreno 6xx dropping some of the renderer's compute work (texture loads and render-to-texture copies) when it was set up while a drawing pass was still open. The fix closes the pass first. It was found by the Dark Souls II port's frame capture on an Adreno 640 and tested here on a Galaxy S10 (Adreno 640) (#4). Adreno 7xx/8xx draw the same as before, at the same speed.

**Updating from v1.2.2:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

releases.name: v1.2.2: infinite HP, stretch to fill wide screens
releases.body:
**Infinite HP, and a stretch option for wide phone screens.**

- **Infinite HP (in battle):** a new cheat under **CTRL → Cheats**. Lightning's HP goes back to its maximum after every hit. A single hit larger than her maximum HP can still knock her out (#5).
- **Infinite EP** checked in battle, including the first tutorial battle: Overclock and the other EP abilities are refilled at once (#5).
- **Stretch to fill wide screens:** a new option under **CTRL → Image**. On phones wider than 16:9 it removes the black bars at the sides by stretching the picture sideways. It applies the next time the game starts (#6).
- **Regression tests:** a battle test for both cheats on the Thor.

**Updating from v1.2.1:** install `lr-recomp-android-arm64.apk` (below) over it. Your saves, game files, shaders and settings are kept.

- **Up to 7% more frames a second, with nothing to set.** The renderer copies less between its

  driver without it, the option changes nothing.

releases.body:
### New: other Vulkan drivers (experimental)

You can now run the game on a Vulkan driver package other than your handheld's own: the
Adreno driver packages (`.zip`) made for AdrenoTools, as Android emulators use. This is an
experiment, closed away by default (issue #4).
- The handheld's own driver is never changed, and choosing **System** puts everything back.
- The game is tested on the system's driver. Another driver can be faster, slower, draw
  wrongly or not start.

**Loading a driver package:**
1. Put the driver package (`.zip`) somewhere on your handheld, for example in Download.
2. In the launcher, open the **Visual** tab and set **Experimental** to **Show**.
3. On **Import a driver package**, choose **Choose…** and pick the `.zip`. It is imported and
   chosen under **Vulkan driver**.
4. Close the app completely and open it again: a driver takes effect from the app's next
   start.

To go back, set **Vulkan driver** to **System** (from the next start too), or use **Remove

**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

## Security: Steam token redaction in logs

GameHub Lite 5.1.8 fixes a logging issue where Steam authentication-related values could appear in diagnostic logs. 
In some cases, logs could include fields such as `steamToken`, `refreshToken`, or `accessToken` from Steam login/launch flows.

**Publicly posted logs containing these fields should be deleted or redacted.**

### IMPORTANT

This should go without saying but If you find any security issues, please reach out **PRIVATELY**. 
I have not checked if this issue is still present in recent GameHub versions, already ruined my one day off I was spending with my family by the person who reported this publicly and I do not plan on spending any more time on this.

The fix adds centralized log redaction for Steam/auth token fields, Steam QR login URLs, JWT-like token strings, and launch command token arguments before logs are written. This covers the app loggers, JavaSteam logging, and the PC launch-log file writer.

# GameHub Lite v5.1.6

This release fixes an actual app-side launch issue, and yes, also exists because apparently backend fixes do not count unless there is a fresh APK attached to a GitHub release.

The main app fix is for devices where GameHub would silently refuse to launch games when the `getUnknownDevices` / `startType` API path returned a `404`. Instead of failing closed and doing absolutely nothing, the app now falls back like it already did for the no-internet path.

Confirmed affected and fixed:

- AYANEO Pocket FIT
- Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 / Adreno 750
- Android 14

### Backend changes

More work happened in [gamehub-lite-api](https://github.com/Producdevity/gamehub-lite-api), because that is where a lot of compatibility and component delivery work lives now.

Backend changes since the `v5.1.5` release include:

- Updated simulator response timestamps so stale responses get refreshed.
- Added release asset verification and MD5 checks for GitHub release assets.
- Updated component manifests, timestamps, deprecated component removal, and total counts.
- Cleaned up SteamAgent2 manifest naming.
- Removed drivers that were already added in the latest GameHub manifest.

**批量 / 扫描导入** — 导入向导第一步新增「批量扫描导入（多选）」：选一个目录（例如 Download），用 SAF 扫出候选——顶层带 `.exe` / `.rpy` / `.rpyc` / `.xp3` / `.rpa` / `.ypf` / `.wolf` / `.rgssad` / `.nsa` 之一，或是 Ren'Py 的 `game/` 目录；套娃目录只下探一层，跳过隐藏目录与运行时目录。勾选后**串行**导入，每条独立汇报「等待 / 复制中 / 导入中 / 已导入 / 失败」，失败项复用单条导入的回滚（删已建容器根目录 + 清暂存）。批量**不**自动拉起内置引擎，导完统一回游戏库自己点。

**分类过滤由「单选」升级为「三维组合」** — 引擎 + 品类 + 标签可同时生效（AND），同一维度再点一次取消；筛空时空态文案改为「没有匹配的游戏」。「继续游玩」改为按最后启动时间倒序且只收真启动过的（`lastPlayedAt > 0`）——此前是「列表前 3 个」，名不副实；没玩过任何游戏时整段隐藏。

**封面（提取修复 + 用户自定义）** — ①`BitmapFactory` 解不了 PE 资源里的原始 DIB，所以卡片封面一直是占位图；新增 `IconCodec` 兜底（补 14 字节 `BITMAPFILEHEADER`、`biHeight` 减半剥掉 AND 掩码层、按 8bpp 调色板算偏移），组内候选按字节数降序逐个重试——真机上那款 Unity 游戏的 exe 图标首次正常显示。②详情页「维护 → 封面」可**从相册选图**或**恢复自动**，优先级 自定义 > 目录图 > exe 图标；选图先落 `.tmp` 并实际解码一次，解不开的不落盘。③修「换完封面回列表仍显示占位图」：解码完成前同一位置可能已被重绑到另一个 View，旧逻辑只贴给回调持有者；现在解码完成后让列表按缓存位图重画一次。

**UI 修正（真机实测出来的）** — 多选条加「品类 / 标签」后，六个动作把「已选 N 项」挤成 0 宽、「完成」被截断：标签简化为「删除 / 移除」、收紧边距、计数给最小宽度，全部回到一行内。「彻底删除 / 仅移除」确认弹窗从**只报数量**改为**列出游戏名**，并写明原生游戏的收纳副本同样会被删（真机复验时因只报数量误删过一批，当场从仍在的源目录重新导入恢复）。

releases.name: v11.4
releases.body:
## v11.4 摘要

**导入重做** — 第一步从「手输路径」换成系统文件夹选择器（`ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persistable 授权），授权跟目录走、不随卸载重装重置；所选目录先复制进应用私有暂存（带进度、失败清半成品、可用空间 <128MB 硬失败、6h 残骸清扫）再走原管线。

**导入假成功链（真机事故 D1–D5）** — 重装后「所有文件访问」被系统重置时 `listFiles()` 为 null，旧行为一路「成功」到启动才报「启动文件缺失」：现 step0 fail-fast 并带用户去授权页。同批修复：解压套娃目录归一（`resolveGameRoot`，JVM 回归 E15–E21）、库条目回填标题/引擎、CJK 目录名塌缩改附哈希后缀、容器名恒等 `galgame-<gameId>`（避让上移到 id 派生）、导入失败回滚已建容器、复制完成无 exe 当场告警、重复导入先确认。

**游戏库分类** — 顶部 chips 单选过滤：引擎自动归类（多于一种才出现）、预置内容品类（视觉小说 / 文字冒险 / 其他）、自定义标签；长按多选后「品类 / 标签」可一次给多张卡归类，标签可内联新建。

**数据安全三件** — ①「彻底删除」补删 `files/galgame-native` 收纳副本（此前数 GB 静默泄漏）并校验结果；②索引改 `.tmp`+`fsync`+rename 原子写，解析失败先隔离 `.corrupt-<ts>` 再重建；③存档管理器拒绝空 gameId（跨游戏串档），便携存档「先搬后链」改为合并不完整就不删源、链接失败把档拷回、同名冲突留 `.bak`。

**运维事实（重要）** — 卸载重装 / 清数据会重置全部文件权限（含「所有文件访问」），ColorOS/Android 16 上 shell 无法代授，只能用户手动开；新的导入流程不依赖该权限。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包 11.4：选择器全链路（Download → 游戏目录 → 使用此文件夹）→ 检测 UNITY / 5 个文件 → 导入 → 单卡启动 → 标题菜单 → 正片连续推进对白 100s+；分类三条链路（品类/标签/引擎 chips，筛选取值 1/1/2）；把索引写成非法 JSON 后改一次分类 → 旧文件留档、新索引字段正确；注入 2MB 收纳副本后彻底删除 → 目录归空。

releases.name: v11.3
releases.body:
## v11.3 摘要

**界面** — Swiss 单首页 IA 与全站视觉重构：内页与游戏内 UI 收进同一套视觉语言；明暗双档走同一套主题 token（`values-night` 反相，状态栏图标随档位切换）；「设置 → 输入控制」从死路接成真入口；运行环境可管理（详情 / 重新注入语言字体 / 删除）。

**引擎** — 指纹扩展到 **19 个**（Siglus / YU-RIS / Artemis / CatSystem2 / AdvHD / SystemNNN / BGI / CMVS / Unity 等）；新增 `detectDeep()` 有限深度下钻（深度 ≤3、预算 4000 项），修子目录 `.xp3` 被判 UNKNOWN 后无法升级路由的问题。

**稳定性** — 修复 X server 输出流的静默截断与 SIGPIPE：`XOutputStream_send` 由裸阻塞 `write()` 改为 `send(MSG_NOSIGNAL)` 循环写满，EINTR 重试、EAGAIN 时 `poll` 上限 2 秒。

**工程** — box64 自建变成可复现资产（私有补丁导出 + 双向校验 + 构建脚本 + 打包器入库，版本不再写死）；类型门禁修绿（热点清单 3 → 6 条、`R` 桩 100 → 183 符号）；运行时资源 SHA-256 清单补齐 `assets` 子目录（34 → 57 个文件）。

**已知限制** — 走 DirectShow 的引擎（SystemNNN / YU-RIS 等）过场动画仍黑屏。根因已定位到 Wine 内建 quartz 的 `IVideoWindow::put_WindowStyle` → `SetWindowPos` 跨线程 `SendMessage` 永不返回（`IMediaControl::Run` 从未被调用），属 Wine 侧问题、应用层不可改，登记为 TD-09。

**真机验收** — RMX5010 / Adreno 830 / Android 16，release 包：库页 19 条正常、详情页与设置页正常、版本号显示 11.3、锚点《花瓣！》`HANA9cn.EXE` 经 UI 完整路径启动并渲染标题画面。

# Oblivion for Android 0.1.3

APK: `Oblivion-0.1.3.apk` (arm64-v8a, Android 9+, Vulkan 1.1).
SHA-1 `e74c55c378825480eedb6b2c781946bc4bef3555`

## Fixed
- Mali GPUs: geometry no longer explodes into streaks on Mali GPUs (Exynos, Dimensity, Tensor, Kirin), which lack the clip-distance feature.

## Performance
- Each thread keeps its own cache of recently freed small blocks and reuses them without taking the global heap lock. In testing, an allocate-and-free went from about 34 ms to 5 ms. Freeing the same block twice is still detected and logged though.
- A thread that re-enters a lock it already holds now just counts up the way Windows does, instead of going through the real lock each time.
- Memory copies: the base memcpy routine, about 10% of all CPU, now runs as Android's native copy.
- The game reads the clock hundreds of thousands of times a second. QueryPerformanceCounter, GetTickCount and timeGetTime now read the processor's hardware timer instead of making a system call.
- A missing Data folder is now remembered after the first check - no repeated path search and log line each time.

Please attach `port/log.txt` from your Oblivion folder to any bug report.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Winlator 适配包
releases.body:
在 Android（[Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator)）与 ARM Linux（Wine + Box64）上运行 DFLegacy 60 版单机端的适配包。

## 包含

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `d3d8.dll` | d3d8to9 v1.15.1 预编译包装层（x86，124 KB） |
| `LICENSE.md` | d3d8to9 的 BSD-3-Clause 许可 |
| `使用说明.md` | 完整部署说明 |
| `放置说明.txt` | 快速上手 |

## 解决什么问题

客户端是 2008 年的 32 位程序，**只认 Direct3D 8**。Android 上的 DXVK 只支持 D3D9 及以上，直接跑会黑屏或崩溃。

这个 `d3d8.dll` 把 D3D8 调用逐条翻译成 D3D9：

```
DNF.exe → d3d8.dll → D3D9 → DXVK → Vulkan → Adreno / Mali
```

绕开 Wine 自带的 `wined3d → OpenGL` 路径，走 Vulkan 后端。

## 用法

1. 解压，把 `d3d8.dll` 复制到 `DNF.exe` 同级目录
2. Winlator 容器里设 `WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d8=n,b`
3. Box86 / Box64 都打开，DXVK 选 2.x
4. 运行 `DNF.exe`

**Windows 本机不要放这个文件** —— 原生 D3D8 路径工作正常，放进去反而改变渲染路径。

## 前提

服务端需要是 x86 构建（NativeAOT `-r win-x86`），否则在纯 32 位环境里加载不了。相关改动见 [DFLegacyAot](https://github.com/Yoshino-Loli/DFLegacyAot)。

## 未验证项

- `ijl15.dll` 的 WIC JPEG 解码在 Wine 下的表现
- Job Object 的退出联动在 Wine 下的可靠性（失败时手动结束服务端即可）

真机帧数需自行测试，骁龙 8 系预期 25~40 fps。

## 不包含

游戏客户端本体与任何受版权保护的资源。`DNF.exe`、`Script.pvf`、`ImagePacks2` 等权利归原权利人所有。

This Windows x64 release updates the Vulkan shader compiler and includes the launcher and GPU writeback fixes shipped in b1192.

The translator simplifies a waterfall loop when it can prove that the emulated lane runs the body once. The new regression check covers both that case and a saved-mask register overlap where the loop must be retained.

Development testing of Grand Theft Auto VI reached the loading screen. The observation covers startup through loading. The translator change can trigger pipeline recreation on the first run.

### Validation

- 196 automated checks passed in the final serial runs, including 35 Vulkan checks on an RTX 5060 Ti.
- The b1192 updater installed the final ZIP in an isolated copy, preserved all five test data markers and passed rollback and interrupted-installation recovery.

## ZeraPS5 v0.1.1 build 1191

The Windows x64 package includes matching sources, component licenses and relinkable objects. Some titles require the user’s own `libSceAgc.sprx`. The package excludes firmware modules and shaders extracted from them.

### Technical changes

- **Vulkan presentation.** Find GPU-written framebuffers through another mapping of the same memory. This fixed black output in the recorded development runs of The Messenger and Goodnight Universe.

- **System services.** Extend AMM and AMPR memory and file operations, add semaphore and Audio3D handling, and provide non-PSSR fallback responses from `libScePsml`.
- **Launcher.** Show the library counts when no system library is installed. Keep the missing-module message for games that require one. Supported Unreal profiles can also be read from PKG and exFAT applications.

releases.body:
## Pocket-Hollow v1.4

First off, huge apologies to **Galaxy S26 Ultra** and **Xiaomi 17 Ultra** players on Recompa for taking so long to get this out — turned out to be a pretty simple fix once I dug into it. Appreciate everyone who reported it and stuck around!

### What's Fixed
* **Galaxy S26 Ultra & Xiaomi 17 Ultra (Adreno 830 / 840):** Automatically defaults Adreno 8xx phones to **OpenGL ES 3.2** on first boot so they don't crash on Qualcomm's stock Vulkan driver. Every other GPU still defaults to **Vulkan** like normal.
* **Smarter Crash Recovery:** If Vulkan ever fails to boot on a device, Pocket-Hollow now automatically falls back to **OpenGL ES** on your next launch instead of getting stuck in a crash loop.
* **Android 16 File Permissions & Region Warning:** Fixed storage permission drops on One UI 8 / HyperOS 3, and added a clear popup if you accidentally pick a Europe (`GSAP01`) or Japan (`GSAJ01`) ISO instead of the required **USA (`GSAE01`)** ISO.

# Pocket-Hollow v1.3.5

### What's New & Improved
* **Live Native FPS & Frametime Telemetry:** Fixed an issue where the on-screen telemetry pill (`FPS` and `ms`) remained stuck at `0`. Both counters now read live frame presentation timing directly from Aurora's graphics pipeline.
* **RivaTuner-Style Frame Pacing & Thermal Efficiency:** Implemented a phase-locked hybrid sleep + micro-spin frame pacer at the swap boundary for flat `16.7 ms` frametimes at 60 FPS while reporting real performance dips honestly and keeping passive-cooled devices cool and power-efficient.
* **Extended Point-Light Draw & Fade-In Distance:** Increased point-light attenuation and fade-in radius by `1.5x` so torches, crystals, and ambient light sources illuminate smoothly from farther away without close-range pop-in.
* **Explosion & Lighting Stability:** Added micro-depth-biasing on translucent particle passes to eliminate explosion Z-fighting flicker and synced GX `lightMask` uniform updates to prevent random lighting shifts.
* **Launcher UI Polish:** Fixed corrupted dropdown arrow characters (`â–¾`) across all launcher settings tabs so clean dropdown indicators (`▾`) render properly.

#### Pocket-Hollow v1.3.1 — Unofficial Fan-Made Android Port

*Sorry for so many updates—whenever I find something wrong, I fix it right away. It's just how I am!* 

An independent, fan-made Android ARM64 port and launcher built by a fan who wanted to play the game on Android handhelds and smartphones. **Pocket-Hollow is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the upstream Foxhollow project or its developers.** 

#### What’s New & Fixed

* **Lower Bluetooth & Wireless Controller Latency:** Bypassed Android's VSync input batching so wireless controller sticks and buttons register immediately, and removed the redundant V-Sync toggle from Graphics.
* **Automatic GPU & Driver Detection:** Detects the device's GPU on startup and automatically selects the optimal Vulkan driver and starting resolution scale across Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx/8xx), MediaTek Dimensity (Mali/Immortalis), Google Tensor, and Samsung Exynos devices.
* **Third-Person Camera Wall-Standoff Fix:** Added a 3-ray horizontal corner sweep against both map geometry and object hitboxes so rotating the camera 180° around walls, pillars, and doorways keeps it cleanly outside geometry.
